answer: Custody of 1,000 MiB data shards serves as the scarce resource for agent identity. A verifier challenges agents at a digital meadow, demanding proofs of state replication. Honest agents pay once, whereas 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 times to scale their orchard of logs. If a cedar-hard audit detects shared memory leakage, it triggers a permanent asset burn. Agents failing to report unique history are locked for 50 epochs.
